title: Teach compaction boundaries and invariants about developer messages
objective: Preserve valid developer catalog items through compaction boundary selection and invariant checks without breaking tool-use/result pairing.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Classify RoleDeveloper explicitly in compaction boundaries.
Prevent orphaning or reordering catalog messages around user/tool groups.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Audit all role switches in the owned files.
Add developer-before-user, boundary, partial-compaction, and tool-pair tests.
Fail closed on unsupported role layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Developer catalog items are neither silently dropped nor treated as assistant output.
dispatch_prompt: Update compact boundary and invariant logic for RoleDeveloper with focused tests. Modify only compact.go, invariants.go, and the new test.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
